relationships.subject: localized vibration
relationships.evidence_quote: The spinal gate control mechanism through Aβ-fibers activation seems to be the most effective antinociceptive system activated by LV at frequencies between 100 and 250 Hz

relationships.subject: localized vibration
relationships.evidence_quote: Decrease in calcitonin and TRPV1 expression in the trigeminal ganglia in animals has been induced by HF-LV

relationships.subject: localized vibration
relationships.evidence_quote: Both high and low LV induce the release of oxytocin, which may induce antinociceptive responses in animals and contribute to controlling pain in humans.

key_findings: High-frequency localized vibration analgesia is mainly via Aβ-fiber spinal gate control, with additional higher-level effects.
HF-LV decreased calcitonin and TRPV1 expression in animal trigeminal ganglia; both LV types release oxytocin.
